title: Mixed Event — SEKAI Happy New Year! — Episode6 Hanetsuki Battle!

meta.Event Outline: Celebrate the New Year with Miku and the others in SEKAI! Get ready for a special episodic story featuring all group members!

rows.Line: New Year's Day
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hello, everyone!
Here's the special New Year's menu.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, red bean soup with red and white dango, and amazake smoothies! Also, a matcha latte with flowers on the dango.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Your special menu is so extravagant! I don't know what to pick...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! I want to try everything!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I've been looking forward to your special menu, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe, I went to town on this one.
Order anything you like!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay! Len, what are you getting?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Or how about we order everything from the New Year's menu one by one and share them all?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, let's do that! I'll have the matcha latte then!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And I'll have the red bean soup!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: One matcha latte and one red bean soup. Got it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: For my first order of the year, I'd like a cup of your original house blend, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe, sure.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hanging out with everyone and just enjoying a relaxing day really is the best part of New Year's...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes. It is very nice, but don't get too lazy!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, we probably should find a way to work off all of this food...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Want to go jogging with me after this?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Jogging?
But just running is so boring.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Aww... Fine, what do you want to do?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, more customers...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, MEIKO! Happy New Year!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And Happy New Year to you too, An.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Wow, everyone's here today!
Happy New Year!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Happy New Year!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hey, Akito and Toya are here too!
Happy New Year!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Happy New Year. Thanks for all the help this past year.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Let's find the time to sing together again too.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, of course! We're looking forward to it!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What's everyone up to right now?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Just making the most of our New Year's in a really relaxed fashion.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe, that's the best way to spend it!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Len and I were also talking about finding a way to burn off all the calories from MEIKO's extravagant menu too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Well, if you want to do that, I've got just the thing! Wanna try it?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, Hanetsuki paddles!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, what are those for...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They're special paddles used as a New Year's decorations. Supposedly, they bring you good health for the entire year.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, okay...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And you can play a game with them too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You use the paddles like rackets to bounce a shuttlecock back and forth. The player that misses it loses...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
So it's a Hanetsuki battle!
That sounds really fun!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Count me in too!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: This game's also supposed to ward off misfortune, so why not play doubles since you brought four rackets?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But there's one thing that hasn't been mentioned. The loser gets their face painted with ink, so you want to be careful not to get all graffitied.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Can't they just leave that part out...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Then we just have to win, right?
Don't worry, we've got this!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That's right! Len and I make the perfect team, so we'll definitely win♪

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Then Kohane and I will play against you. The winners can scribble whatever they like on the loser's faces just as an added incentive!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, An...! Really?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Don't worry, Kohane!
We're an unbeatable team!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Says YOU!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: How about you, Akito? Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I've never actually played Hanetsuki before...
Have you, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Only once when I was a little kid.
I'm happy just watching.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You guys are no fun! We're gonna have a blast without them in that case!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's go outside!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'd like to see this too.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: In that case, I'll get your orders ready and keep them in the back until you're done.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Cool, thanks!
Let's go, guys!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We've gotta win, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, we'll win and prove to the world that we're the best team ever!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hehe, look at how cocky they are!
Let's show them who's boss, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's play our best!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We'll just watch from here then...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, what about practice? Sigh... I guess we can do that later since it's New Year's and all...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Are you ready to begin?
I'll be the referee!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You score one point if your opponents fail to hit the shuttlecock.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The first to five will be the winner. Is that okay with everybody?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, sounds good!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Same here!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay. Let's start the Hanetsuki Battle!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Here goes! Haaah!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Len, it's on your side!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I've got this... Huh? I missed...?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Nice!
That's one point for us!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: These paddles have a strange shape, so it's not easy to hit the shuttlecock with them.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Well, that's unfortunate for Len! Guess what comes next...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Y-Yeah! Come on then, paint my face already...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: An, can you paint my face too?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Len and I are a team, so I think it's only fair we get the same treatment!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe, you're really two peas in a pod.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay then....!
I can do the same thing for both of you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Just a little dab here, and done!
Okay, your turn, Rin...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Eek, it tickles!
This is fun! I kinda like it!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Haha! Okay, time to get serious and score some points for our team!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane, get it!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah! Got it...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh no! A drop shot...!
I won't reach it...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But I have to make it! Gooo!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
You got it!
Nice one, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That was awesome, Rin!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: My turn, huh? You're next, Len!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Alright, I'm ready!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (If Rin can pull that off, so can I!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: There!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'm on it! Yeah!!!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Whaaat?!
I was sure Len would miss that!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Good job, Len! We scored a point!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's keep this up!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I-I'm sorry, An! It took me by surprise...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's all good. We'll get back at them!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This should get interesting.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Bring it on, ladies!
You can't beat me and Rin!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You're going to regret asking for it, Len!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Here you go!!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hehe, I saw that one coming!
Got it!!
